title: China, Japan slam Donald Trump’s new tariff plans

ai.summary: US proposed new tariffs targeting multiple countries, including China (20% tariff), Japan (up to 15%), and Singapore (20%), which have criticized the move as a pretext for political maneuvering and excess capacity claims.

facts.claim: US proposed new tariffs targeting multiple countries
facts.quote: The new tariffs, which are likely to take effect early next year, were announced Wednesday.
China, one of the biggest trading partners of the US, is facing a 20 per cent tariff.
Japan faces new US tariffs of up to 15 per cent.
Singapore, due to be hit by a 20 per cent tariff rate, said it was "very disappointed" with the US proposal.

facts.claim: China criticized the move as a pretext for political maneuvering
facts.quote: "China opposes its use as a pretext for political manoeuvring," Guo Jiakun, a spokesperson for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, said at a regular press briefing.

facts.claim: Japan stated it does not have excess capacity
facts.quote: "Japan does not have any nonmarket policies or practices, or structural excess production capacity in the first place," Chief Cabinet Secretary Minoru Kihara told a regular news conference Thursday.
